title: AW Center
purpose: Find available application shortcuts.
steps: Choose a tool from the home page or menu.
limitations: Visibility follows current permissions.

title: Integration Hub
purpose: Review integration configuration and reported status.
steps: Open the hub and review each reported state.
limitations: Configured status does not guarantee upstream health.

title: Job Center
purpose: Track your durable jobs and private results.
outputs: Progress, terminal state and retained downloads
steps: Open your job; cancel active work or download completed output when available.
limitations: Only authorized jobs and retained artifacts are available.

title: Accelerator
purpose: Inspect a file for automation recipes and queue a chosen workflow.
steps: Upload a file; select a suggested recipe or choose manually; review and queue.
limitations: Recipes and workers depend on deployment configuration.

title: Outlook Task
purpose: Parse Outlook MSG mail information and attachments.
outputs: Mail metadata, body and private attachments
steps: Upload MSG; review parsed information; use attachment/task controls.
limitations: Private downloads require your session. The assistant cannot access your mailbox or send mail.

title: DOORS PoC Linker
purpose: Queue PoC link inspection or creation.
outputs: Durable job and complete JSON result
steps: Enter displayed inputs; choose inspection or creation; confirm writes and track the job.
limitations: Requires Windows DOORS worker. Link creation writes to DOORS.

title: DOORS Agent
purpose: Queue a module quality check and inspect findings.
steps: Enter the module path; queue the check; inspect or download completed results.
limitations: Requires enabled DOORS and Windows worker. No arbitrary DXL execution.

title: DOORS Script Generator
purpose: Generate DXL text from Excel column mappings.
inputs: XLSX/XLSM file, DOORS mappings and search column
steps: Upload workbook; map columns and select search item; generate and copy script.
limitations: Does not execute generated scripts. DXL Library delivery is disabled.

title: Teamcenter
purpose: Inspect objects and queue idempotent property updates.
steps: Check configuration; inspect UIDs; review and queue property updates.
limitations: Requires configured integration. Property updates are external writes.

title: Compare
purpose: Compare old/new Word, Excel or PDF content.
inputs: Two supported files, matching preset and report format
steps: Upload files; choose preset/report; inspect and select Excel tables/columns if applicable; compare and download.
limitations: Word/PDF text only, no OCR/image/layout comparison. Excel formulas are not evaluated; one table per file.

title: PDF Split
purpose: Split one PDF into smaller PDFs.
inputs: PDF and number of parts or pages per part
steps: Upload PDF; select one splitting mode; split and download.
limitations: Use only one splitting mode at a time.

title: Media Converter
purpose: Estimate size and queue media format conversion.
inputs: Media file, output extension, optional dimensions/bitrate
outputs: Size estimate and private converted output
steps: Select file/settings; preview estimated size if needed; queue and download result.
limitations: Estimate is not guaranteed final size. Requires supported formats and conversion tools.

title: Translator
purpose: Queue Word translation using local models.
steps: Upload file; choose direction; queue and download after completion.
limitations: Requires local models and worker.

title: DDF Assistant
purpose: Browse DDF records and use permitted upload and analysis controls.
outputs: Table, record details, graph and analysis
steps: Filter/open a record; use permitted upload/edit/analysis controls.
limitations: DDF view or add permission required; individual actions need their own permissions.

title: Powerpoint Gallery
purpose: Process presentations and browse slides.
steps: Upload presentation; track processing; select the presentation and browse slides.
limitations: Requires supported formats and worker. Assistant does not create/edit slides.

title: JIRA
purpose: Use Watcher and permitted DCC/subtask workflows.
inputs: JIRA connection, authorized project and task inputs
steps: Connect through the page; choose authorized project/tab; review inputs and follow its workflow.
limitations: DCC role required; creation requires operator/publisher. Never put credentials in assistant chat.

title: Organization
purpose: Browse people, panels and responsibility assignments.
steps: Select project; open People/Panels/Responsibles; use role-permitted controls.
limitations: Organization role required; management requires manager. Global directory writes also require directory permission.

title: Compliance Docs Home
purpose: Review the authorized compliance dashboard.
steps: Open dashboard and navigate to an authorized project register.
limitations: Requires enabled compliance-capable project and domain role; assistant cannot read live records.

title: Doc Analyzer
purpose: Queue private document analysis with checks and custom questions.
inputs: Document, selected checks and optional questions
steps: Upload supported document; choose checks/questions; queue and download result.
limitations: Requires configured analysis services and worker; human review needed.

title: Cover Page Creator
purpose: Validate Excel columns and create compliance cover pages.
steps: Upload workbook; resolve missing columns; queue and download result.
limitations: Requires templates/worker; missing columns prevent queueing.

title: Developer DOORS
purpose: Queue module checks and object create/update operations.
steps: Check availability; enter inputs; review and queue operation.
limitations: Staff required. Operations run in Windows worker, without arbitrary DXL or browser COM.

title: Developer Test Data
purpose: Preview and prepare development compliance/organization data reset.
inputs: Preview, preparation state and exact confirmation phrase
steps: Preview counts; prepare cancellation or release; resolve blockers and follow explicit confirmation.
limitations: Development mode and superuser only. Permanently removes compliance/organization data across projects. Assistant cannot reset data.

title: Users
purpose: Browse accounts and permitted account/role controls.
steps: Find/open account; use available management controls.
limitations: Staff plus auth.view_user or auth.add_user, or superuser. Writes require their own permissions.
